profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at T-Mobile
profile.summary:
•	Over 10+ as an Experienced Professional Technologist.
•	Over 6+ years working as iOS Software Developer. Experience includes the whole development cycle of a software project: software engineering, bug tracking, product design, release planning, customer support, version control, iTunes Connect submission lifecycle and marketing. Ability to solve problems and think as a user and identify UX issues. 
•	Strong experience in Objective C (6 years) and Swift (2 years) with several apps published in the App Store using Xcode and Interface Builder working with UIKit, iOS HIG, Core Data, Networking, Localization, Accessibility, UI Storyboarding, XIB’s, AutoLayout for iPhone and iPad interfaces, Cocoapods, Fabric.io (Crashlytics) for performance and crash reports, Google Analytics for analytics tracking.
•	RESTful. Experience developing network layer integrating mobile apps with web-services and external APIs using native (NSURLSession) and third-party libraries like AFNetworking, Alamofire& SwiftyJSON handling JSON &XML responses. Comfortable with Postman for test and API development.
•	Security. Experience working with Touch & Face ID, Keychain, CryptoSwift, Facebook and Google Authentication systems as well as login mechanism using OAUTH tokens.
•	MBaaS (Mobile Backend as a Service). Experience working with cloud services like Google Firebase, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Heroku.
•	Android development since 2017. Experience working with Android Studio, Android SDK, Java, Android XML layouts, offline storage using SQLite, experience consuming web services HTTP REST interaction with JSON. Frameworks and libraries experience: Picasso, ButterKnife, Multidex, Volley, Gson, Google Maps, okhttp. 
•	Experience working with teams using the Scrum Agile Methodology and continuous integration using Fastlane and some basics of Jenkins. Comfortable with various source control utilities such SourceTree, GitHub, GitLab, SmartGit using git-flow workflow.

positions.title: iOS Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Focused on design, develop, deployment and maintenance of iOS SDKs infrastructure required for T-Mobile apps data collection and enabling the enterprise to access and leverage that data. Monitoring the data creation and flow for quality. Diving for cases of quick problem solving, or longer-term root cause analysis.

positions.title: macOS & iOS Developer
positions.description:
Project: Timerous App for Mac
Description: Productivity App that helps users plan, track & analyze the time spent in different projects at work. It uses the Pomodoro Technique and others strategy to help user maintain the focus and motivation to do the important things.
Languages, tools and Frameworks: Objective-C, Swift, Xcode, CoreData, WebKit, Cocoa, Carbon, AppKit, ServiceManagement, Automator, Fabric, Crashlytics, MASShortcut, macOS
Responsibilities: 
•	Product design, product development, version control
•	iTunes Connect submission lifecycle
•	Release planning, customer support, bug tracking and marketing
App link: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/id1330506498?l=en&mt=12

positions.title: KeepCoding Startup Bootcamp Engineering Master
positions.description: The goal is to become a Full Stack Developer at the end of this year (2017), specializing in app development (iOS and Android) without leaving behind backend skills with technologies such as NodeJS, Angular, Cloud Computing, among others. With the partners of the course, we are in the final phase that consists of applying everything learned developing an app where we are putting into practice everything we learned and that involves mobile, web, and backend development, cloud computing in AWS using the TDD and Scrum methodologies for agile development of our project.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Project: EIC (Ericsson Indoor Calculator)
Business Domain: Mobile App
Description: Calculator for staff and sellers at Ericsson that allows calculate, make& save budgets and suggest communication equipment for Ericsson customers. Users can login in using their job mail accounts validated by Microsoft Active Directory.
Languages, tools and Frameworks: Objective-C, Xcode, Contacts, AddressBook, MapKit, PNChart, ADALiOS, Microsoft Active Directory Web Services

Responsibilities: 
•	Implement and connect the app with the API’s hosted on Microsoft Azure Cloud services using JSON technology as communication protocol.
•	Creation of several screens of the app (iPhone & iPad), testing and bug fixes.
•	Creation/customization of complex UI controls, animations, blocks, GCD, debugging, Instruments and data management
•	Ensure that app is high performing, high quality, and responsive
•	Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs
•	Help maintain code quality, organization and automation
•	Experiment with and learn new technologies.
•	Analyze and optimize code for efficiency and performance.
•	Encourage innovation, teamwork, self-organization, and diversity.

App link: App not available outside of Ericsson only for internal staff and sellers.

positions.title: VB 6.0 & VB .NET Developer, Microsoft SQL Sever Administrator
positions.description:
Responsibilities: 
•	Focused on design, programming, customization and marketing for a selling point software package for small businesses using Microsoft development tools.
•	Manage SQL Server databases through multiple product lifecycle environments, from development to mission-critical production systems.
•	Implements and maintains automated database maintenance plans and backup routines using standard methodologies.
•	Monitoring of system health and performance, to ensure high levels of performance, availability and security.
•	Maintenance and support release deployment activities.
•	Provide 24 x 7 support for critical production system.

Environment: Visual Basic Studio 6.0, Visual Basic Studio .NET & Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise

•	From repair services, sales and consulting in all kinds of computer equipment. 
•	I was responsible for a small group of technicians; we grew together to a reliable and experienced team in our area.

positions.description: IT Technical Support. Configuration, maintenance and operation of data, mail and printing servers (LAN and wireless). Security, data backups and related.

projects.title: Plan Monitor App
projects.description: Plan Monitor is a App for your iPhone can help you keep track of your minutes, SMS and MB consumed on your monthly phone plan. With a few adjustments this app will be a tool to help you reduce your phone bill. In addition to the above, Plan Monitor keeps you a list of your favorite contacts to whom you can call, send SMS or email to quickly and intuitively.
